data.narrative:
Alpha School is a Series A-stage AI & Software company founded by MacKenzie Price and Brian Holtz. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies: Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B). The broader comparable universe includes nine private firms and one public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) in the AI & Software space.

The peer-median method, the sole applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields an implied valuation of $4.4B. This reflects the median across the four-company peer set, which spans a range from $2.0B to $25.0B. The wide interquartile spread, particularly the outlier positioning of Reflection AI at $25.0B relative to the three Series B peers clustered between $2.0B and $5.6B, introduces material variance around the central estimate.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.8B (low) to $5.1B (high) with a median point of $4.4B. Key uncertainties include the limited methodological diversification—only peer-median analysis is currently applicable—and the heterogeneity within the peer set itself, particularly whether Reflection AI's Series A valuation represents a durable market signal or an outlier. Revenue multiples, growth rates, and unit economics remain unspecified and would strengthen conviction around this range.
